text: Mokaben Inc. and By The Way Café have operated a sidewalk patio at 400 Bloor Street West for many years in the same location, long predating the City’s sidewalk patio guidelines. This is a valuable local institution with significant local support, which does not adversely affect pedestrian access, and should be permitted to continue.
Item MM10.4 was withdrawn at City Council on September 6, 2023.
